stories.event: The French Senate holds its solemn vote on the whole 2027 social security financing bill (PLFSS) on Wednesday 18 November at 16:30, after a week of rewriting the government's text, which the National Assembly rejected on 23 October. The right-centre majority (LR 124, centrists 63, Les Indépendants 15) is expected to adopt it; the left and the RN group oppose the partial freeze of pensions. Last year the Senate adopted the PLFSS 2026 by 196 votes to 119.

research.finding: 2025 (scrutin n°61, 26 Nov 2025): 196 pour, 119 contre, 27 abstentions. RDPI abstained 19/19, RDSE voted 14 contre and 3 abstentions, and the left and the non-inscrits voted all contre. No 2026 group voting announcements were found (explications de vote come on 18 Nov).
